test_layers_einsum: test the layers.Einsum class to perform einsum operations with configurable weight shapes, bias shapes, and Einstein summation equations
test_layers_rmsnorm: test the layers.RMSNorm class to apply root mean square normalization to input tensors with a given width
test_layers_scan: test the layers.scan.linear_scan function to perform linear or associative native scans over sequences with reset masks
test_layers_rglu: test the layers.RGLRU class to initialize and apply recurrent GLU operations with optional real-only mode
test_common_scantype: test the common.ScanType enum with LINEAR_NATIVE and ASSOCIATIVE_NATIVE scan types across different sequence lengths and dtypes
